signature_moves: Single warm goldenrod hue as the entire brand system, threaded icon background -> menu-bar glyph tint -> the one CTA (committed colour strategy on a near-white sheet)
Reduction to exactly one field + one send button (frictionless quick-capture), paper-plane 'send' metaphor as connective tissue
defects: Contrast Dilution (CTA label) — white 'SEND' on light-gold capsule ~1.8:1, fails 4.5:1; the one must-hit action is the least legible text
Non-native button label — tracked UPPERCASE 'SEND'; native uses sentence/title case
Brand accent overrides system accent — primary binds to app-yellow, not controlAccentColor
Persistent bottom compose/format bar — messaging pattern, not a native macOS toolbar
Non-native density — ~16-18pt-equiv placeholder and ~44pt touch-tier button vs native 13pt body / 24-28pt controls

aesthetic.direction: warm consumer-utility — single-hue goldenrod identity, pill CTA, generous whitespace; leans Playful/toy + Organic/soft rather than any native macOS register

psychology: Hick's Law / Fogg-reduction — panel exposes one field + one action, minimal decision load for quick capture (exploited well)
Von Restorff effect — the single gold CTA is the one different thing on a neutral sheet, so it pops (exploited)
Jakob's Law — borrows the familiar 'type + send' messaging metaphor so users need no learning, though it is non-native to macOS
Recognition over recall — placeholder-as-only-label ('Write your message') is a mild violation (label vanishes on input), acceptable for a single compose field
Aesthetic-usability effect — warm friendly surface buys first-contact goodwill, undercut by the low-contrast CTA label
notes: Only ONE UI surface exists, and it is the app window inside a MARKETING COMPOSITE (grainy yellow backdrop + heavy grotesk headline + hand-drawn arrow are brand evidence, not app design). No standalone screenshots and no dark-mode evidence were provided. All measurements are ratio-based estimates (arbitrary composite scale) — never treat as measured. The window shows the PRE-RENAME 'Email Me' UI (title reads 'Email Me'); the mic glyph foreshadows the 'Audio Notes' voice pivot. Lineage is genuinely ambiguous: native frame (real coloured traffic lights, centered title) wrapping a non-native body (uppercase branded CTA, chat compose bar, non-13pt density) — the frame-native/body-non-native split is the Electron OR heavily-custom-SwiftUI signature; classified non-native either way, so NONE of its styling should feed macOS canon or native clusters. Era is pre-Tahoe (Big Sur/Ventura wallpaper + Control Center glyph), no Liquid Glass. Icon was NOT run through the icon rubric (task scoped to Workflow A only) — recorded only as brand context.
